name: Aegis the Unbroken
skill: On Summon by any method: you may banish 5 cards from your hand to return all Units in your Discard pile to your deck. All or nothing.

name: Ironhide Sentinel
skill: While this Unit is on the field, your Tower cannot be attacked.

name: Alexia, the Silver Sword
skill: Multistrike - if this Unit wins a combat roll it may attack a second time this Battle Phase. Optional. Maximum 2 attacks per phase.

name: Alfred the Noble Knight
skill: Adjacent Tier 1 and Tier 2 Units you control add +3 to their rolls. Does not buff this Unit.

name: Garrek, the Steel Wind
skill: When this Unit rolls in combat, an even result destroys the enemy Unit outright regardless of its roll.

name: Steadfast Warden
skill: Once per turn: return 1 Honor Dweller Unit from your Discard pile to your deck.

name: Elven Outrider
skill: When this Unit destroys an enemy Unit in combat and its roll was even, your opponent discards 1 random card from their hand.

name: Valen, the Bear Brawler
skill: Units adjacent to this Unit cannot be selected as an attack target.

name: Elvish Sniper
skill: Once per turn: roll this Unit's die. On an odd result, destroy 1 face-up enemy Unit regardless of its roll.

name: Wooden Catapult
skill: Once per turn: roll this Unit's die. On 1 to 4, your opponent chooses 1 Unit they control and sends it to the Discard pile.

name: Standard Bearer
skill: Adjacent Honor Dwellers you control add +2 to their rolls.

name: Honored Drummer
skill: Adjacent Units that are not Honor Dwellers subtract 1 from their rolls.

name: Elvish Beast Caller
skill: On Summon by any method: search your deck for 1 Tier 1 or Tier 2 Forest Dweller and add it to your hand, then shuffle.

name: Monastery Protector
skill: When this Unit destroys an enemy Unit in combat: return 1 card of your choice from your Discard pile to your deck.

name: Monastery Scholar
skill: During your Recruitment Phase: add 1 card from your Discard pile to your deck, then shuffle.

name: Silverlight Dancer
skill: During your Recruitment Phase: return 1 banished Unit to your hand.

name: Makeshift Catapult
skill: Once per turn: if your opponent draws a card outside their Draw Phase, they must immediately discard that card.

name: Makeshift Wall
skill: If a Unit you control adjacent to this Unit would be destroyed, destroy this Unit instead.

name: Makeshift Ballista
skill: Once per turn: roll this Unit's die. Even - mill the top card of your opponent's deck. Odd - destroy this Unit.

name: Orion's Blessing
skill: Discard this card from your hand: force a reroll of any one dice roll.

name: Foraging Foxes
skill: On Summon: draw 1 card.

name: Bear Cave
skill: Once per turn during your Recruitment Phase: discard the top card of your deck to Special Summon 1 Bear Token to the square in front of this Unit.

name: Forest Maple
skill: Once per turn during your Recruitment Phase: shuffle 1 card from your hand into your deck to Special Summon 1 Squirrel Token.

name: Charging Buck
skill: While this Unit is ridden by an Honor Dweller, it adds +2 to its roll.

name: Doe
skill: Once per turn: shuffle 2 cards from your hand into your deck, then draw 2 cards.

name: Shepherd
skill: When this Unit is destroyed in battle: search your Discard pile for a Tier 1 or Tier 2 Forest Dweller and add it to your hand.

name: City Guard Dog
skill: 1 adjacent Unit you control adds +1 to its roll.

name: Town Crier
skill: On Summon: if you have no cards in your hand, draw 5 cards.

name: Bear Token
skill: Token. Not part of your deck. Cannot be Set face-down. Cannot be Tributed. Destroyed permanently when it leaves the field.

name: Squirrel Token
skill: Token. Not part of your deck. Cannot be Set face-down. Cannot be Tributed. Destroyed permanently when it leaves the field.
